precepts.text: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand. This is Bible prophecy.
precepts.point: They are the most needy of any people in our country, the book said. It does say needy, and the Bible says it too.

note.label: The Colossians & The CHRISTIANS of America

precepts.why:
Jeremiah said we would serve strangers in a land that is not ours. The Lamentations goes further: “Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.” Servants have ruled over us. This is Bible prophecy.

It happened in the time of Assyria, Babylon, Persia, Greece, Rome, and America in the present day. It keeps happening over and over again. Why? Because we are the people of God. But this is the last time.

So the masters who took Colossians 3:22 and told us “Servants, obey in all things your masters” were themselves the servants ruling over Israel, just as the prophets lamented, with none to deliver us out of their hand.

precepts.text: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.
precepts.point: Their visage is blacker than a coal, their skin cleaveth to their bones: already black, and blacker in famine; we become hypermelanated when deprived, while the white man gets lighter, and Native Americans in Alaska are still brown, so the cold-climate doctrine is stupid.

note.label: The Superiority of the Chosen People

precepts.why:
“Their visage is blacker than a coal”: their visage means their faces. It was already black; now it is blacker than a coal. “they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.” That is because of the famine, and Lamentations 5:10 says so: “Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.”

During a famine, when our people become malnourished or deprived of food and water, we become hypermelanated. Our skin gets darker because of the effects of famine. When white folks undergo famine, their lack of melanin heightens, and they become lighter than what they already are. So we got blacker because of the famine.

That also knocks down the doctrine that white people moved to a cold climate and that is how they became white. No, they were always that way. And the other side of it, that living on a black continent changed our complexion, is dumb, stupid science. Native Americans moved to Alaska and they are still brown. White people have been living over here since the 1700s; have any of them turned black? It is stupid doctrine.

So Lamentations proves the Israelites were already a black people, whose faces went blacker than a coal in the siege, not a white people darkened by the sun or turned pale by the cold.

precepts.point: We drink our water for money, our wood is sold to us, our necks are under persecution, and we labour and have no rest.

note.label: Latinos For Trump: Alien Vs. Predator

precepts.why:
“Remember, O Lord, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach”: see the curses that fell upon us for our sins. “Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.” The Chicago mayor was offended by the term alien, but the term is in the scriptures. The aliens are the strangers, the other nations. We are not the aliens; we are the natives of these lands. Esau has taken our lands, our resources, our inheritance.

“We are orphans and fatherless.” Why are we orphans? Deuteronomy 28:32: “Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people.” We see it all throughout history, and even now our northern kingdom children are separated from their parents. They killed our fathers, our leaders, the caciques and kings like Atahualpa, and burned them at the stake for not accepting the Christian religion. That is why the Asher in the Amazon grew up orphans and fatherless.

“and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long”. You will look to the white Jesus, but he can't save you. Donald Trump is not going to save you. The US government is not going to save you. No matter how much you perfect your English, the accent is going to slip out and they are going to catch you.

“and there shall be no might in thine hand” to save our children. We saw ICE agents, grown men with weapons and body armor, surrounding a five-year-old autistic girl and holding her hostage: a nation of fierce countenance. How much plainer can it be?

So-called Latinos, you have to see yourselves in the scriptures. You are no different from your black brothers, from Haitians, Jamaicans and African Americans; we are the same people, oppressed together. All these curses have to afflict you so that you can see this is your book, and what is happening to you for turning your back on the black Messiah, Jesus Christ. We have to return to our true nationality.

precepts.point: Our eyes failed for our vain help; we watched for a nation that could not save us. Trump despises the Latinos who serve him.

note.label: Latinos For Trump: Alien Vs. Predator

We are not going into slavery anymore; this one here in America is our last and final captivity. Now it is time for us to wake up and rise up like God's army that we are.

Everything this devil does is going to be revealed, and his judgment for it. So the hand we have given to the oppressor for bread is the hand of Edom, and the cup he made us drink is passing to him.

precepts.point: Servants have ruled over us. The statue of Roosevelt on horseback with a Native and an African man walking beside him shows it.

note.label: Latinos For Trump: Alien Vs. Predator

precepts.why:

We cannot serve idols: Christianity, white Jesus. “for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me”.

That is why Lamentations goes straight on to “Servants have ruled over us”. We bowed to other gods, and a jealous God gave us over to be ruled by the nations. The ones in our own communities who lead our people into thinking we can assimilate, that this is our kingdom, are leading us deeper into it. Our fathers watched for a nation that could not save us, and we are still doing it. The way out is not to serve their idols but to come back to the God who visits the iniquity.

note.label: Christ: the Enemy of Christianity

precepts.why:
Jeremiah cries, “Remember, O Lord, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.” Look at what is happening to us. “Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.” The Bible calls these nations, particularly the white man, strangers and aliens. America takes that term and puts it on Issachar, the Mexicans, on our people from Venezuela, the tribe of Asher, and on our people from Haiti, the tribe of Levi. But they are the real aliens the Bible speaks of; they take our lands and homes.

They kill our fathers and our leaders, so “We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.” Water, which is to be free, they take, bottle and sell to us; the wood of our lands they chop up and sell as merchandise, carpentry, homes and tables. “We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.” Egypt had long been taken down when Jeremiah said this, so the Egyptian here means the oppressor, an oppressive state; Egypt and Assyria were both major oppressors. We have given our hand to the oppressor for him to give us bread.

Then Lamentations 4:17: “As for us”, the 12 tribes of Israel, “our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.” We have watched for America to save us, and God is saying, they cannot save you, just as ancient Egypt could not save us and Assyria could not save our people. We keep looking for salvation to the very nations that oppress us. God said, you are wasting your time with that thing.

precepts.why:

That started with us. When the 12 tribes split, after that split we fell, and the 12 tribes were brought to desolation, with 70 AD soon approaching. But the statement Christ made wasn't just for us. It applied to Rome, which was dominant over us at that time, and to the European nations and countries as well.

“and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand”. You could go deep with that in the house too, husbands and wives divided against each other: if your family is divided, your house is going to fall.

The prophecy shows it coming on spiritual Egypt, Babylon the Great: “And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour”. So the nation we watched to save us is a divided house that cannot stand, and we must not look to it for our help.

precepts.text: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.
precepts.point: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine. It is literal, not only a condition.

note.label: False New Year: Doctrine Slayer - True Past Curses & Trauma

precepts.why:
Lamentations 4:7 shows Israel before: “Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk”. Whiter means holier, more righteous. “more ruddy in body than rubies”: ruddy in body means healthy in body, strong and precious. Then Babylon came, cut off the food supply and starved them out. Verse 7 is the before and verse 8 is the after: “Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.” Their faces could not be recognised from verse 7; they went from ruddy in body to skin hanging off their bones.

Lamentations 5:10 says it plainly: “Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.” What caused the famine? The Babylonians surrounded us, besieged us, cut off our food and water supply, and starved us for years before conquering us entirely. Through starvation we got darker, blacker than a coal.

Why darker? When black folks go through a famine and are starved, there is a thing called hyperpigmentation: they get darker. When white folks get starved, they get lighter; they don't get darker than a coal, they get more pinker than a pig. A plant has its own melanin, chlorophyll, that gives it the green colour; deprive it of water and sunlight and it turns brown and withers, like the Jews here. They were starved and got darker than they already were.

They say it is only talking about the condition the people were in. Yes, it is a condition. When they call us black people today, they mean our condition too, because the black man is the lowest people on this earth today, and the Chinese and the Arabs are above us. But it also means our skin colour. So is our skin symbolic too? “Our skin was black like an oven”, and ovens are black. Stop playing with us.

We bring scripture, history, records from the 1600s, even science, and still they won't accept it, while all the white man has to say is he's white and they say praise Jesus. That is white makes right. The Bible alone is enough: the Israelites were black, and the famine made them blacker.

precepts.text: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.
precepts.point: Thou shalt grope at noonday and not prosper in thy ways.

note.label: False New Year: Doctrine Slayer - True Past Curses & Trauma

precepts.why:
“They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.” They raped our women; they raped the Judahite sisters. This is not new. Whatever color the oppressor was, the nations all had the same habits, because judgment is like a ring: it recurs over and over again. Same game, different characters.

It is the curse of Deuteronomy 28:30: “Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her”. In The Butler, the master takes the boy's mother from the cotton field; she cannot say no; she screams, and the father and everyone in the field stand there powerless, unable to do a thing. In The Birth of a Nation, a guest demands Hark's new wife Esther for the night, and the master allows it; she comes out in tears, and he cries, Where is God now? That racial anger is what drove Nat Turner to take the axe to the master. We were powerless to protect our wives and our children. And “thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein”: we built the house and never dwelt in it.

That trauma is the madness of verse 28: “The Lord shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart”. Coming off those ships we were smitten with madness. In 12 Years a Slave, Patsey, beaten until her back was ripped open for a piece of soap because she could not stand her own smell, begs Solomon Northup to hold her under the water until she is without life, and to bury her in a lonely place; she has no comfort in this life. You cannot expect reparations to fix that. Blindness is spiritual: some watching right now say Jesus and the Jews are white; they are gone. “And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways”, as a nation.

You millennials grew up thinking the white man is peaceful and loving and your friend. Malcolm X, Martin Luther King and our people of the 50s, 60s and 70s knew who the enemy was; after that we forgot and started saying the enemy is only a spiritual demon. They gave us Section 8, food stamps and Christianity, and we went back to sleep. So God is letting Trump and the administration behind him do evil, reverting the white man to his true nature, and JD Vance says they will no longer apologize for being white, so that we develop that racial anger again. That is why they want to remove this history from the museums and the schools. Let your children watch Roots, 12 Years a Slave, The Birth of a Nation, Amistad; the Holy Ghost brings all things to remembrance, and the scripture says what they did to our women in Zion.

precepts.text: Princes are hanged up by their hand.
precepts.point: Princes are hanged up by their hand. Lynching was the fulfilment; they even hung infants about their mothers' necks under Antiochus.

note.label: False New Year: Doctrine Slayer - True Past Curses & Trauma

precepts.why:
“Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.” Princes hanged up means lynched. Young or old, it did not matter; you were hanged all the same.

That is what “thy life shall hang in doubt before thee” comes to. Hanging in doubt does mean you will wonder whether you live or die, worried day and night, in the hood, the ghetto and the slums, and further back in slavery and colonization: “In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning!” But it also means hanging. Lamentations 5 is the whole picture of the curse: “Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens”, the European, the East Indian and the Chinese man in Africa and Trinidad reaping our resources; “We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us”, which is colonization; “Servants have ruled over us”, those who were once our slaves.

The Spaniards hanged the Americans thirteen at a time and set them on fire. Without Sanctuary, a book of lynching photographs, shows it: 1935, which was yesterday; postcards of our fore mothers and fathers hanging from trees; a man burned to pieces, his hands and legs cut off and kept as souvenirs; a mother and son hanged from a bridge in 1901. White people today say, I didn't do that, that was my ancestors. But look at the postcards: children, fathers, mothers, women right in the middle, the whole family supporting it, children who grew up to be your lawyers, teachers, mayors and police officers.

Mary Turner, in 1918, grieving her husband Hayes Turner, lynched without a trial, threatened to have his killers punished. The next day she was hanged from a tree, burned, her womb cut open; the baby, a month shy of being born, cried on the ground, and a member of the white mob crushed its head with his foot; then they shot her full of holes. Now they say they are not apologizing anymore. In Queens in 1976 white children chased little black girls out of their neighborhood with rocks and dogs, calling them niggers, and those children are judges, lawyers and police officers now. This is war.

Hanging is nothing new; the Persians did it (1 Esdras 6:32), “out of his own house should a tree be taken, and he thereon be hanged”. Christ himself was lynched: “whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.” Peter called the cross a tree, wood, where he hung for hours. “Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree”: Christ went under the curse along with us. The King and his children were hanged. Princes are hanged up by their hand.

precepts.text: We are yet this day in our captivity, subject to payments for the iniquities of our fathers.
precepts.point: We have given the hand to the Egyptians and the Assyrians to be satisfied with bread.

note.label: Babylon Speaks Plainly: Venezuela and the Real WMD

precepts.why:
Lamentations cries, “Remember, O Lord, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.” Baruch shows that the reproach is still upon us: “Behold, we are yet this day in our captivity, where thou hast scattered us, for a reproach and a curse, and to be subject to payments, according to all the iniquities of our fathers, which departed from the Lord our God.”

Lamentations goes on: “Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.” “We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.” You are seeing this now, in Cuba, in Venezuela, in parts of Africa. This isn't just for that time; don't tell us that was then, get over it. “We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread”: we have given power, authority and sovereignty over our resources to Egypt and Assyria, to Babylon the Great, the United States, and to other nations. China is working its way into Latin America, and that is why Trump is getting more aggressive going over there now.

“Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.” The whole dynamic of the Monroe Doctrine, the Roosevelt Corollary and the big stick applies to the Northern Kingdom through that verse. We are still paying for the sins of our forefathers, bearing the brunt of it to this very day under all this oppression and economic violence. Chains don't have to be chains no more. Being here in America, we can't always fathom it, but it is not talking about any one person; it is the curse upon our people and our tribes.

“Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.” The captivity now is economic. That is why Baruch says we are yet this day in our captivity, subject to payments. In the base form we say we have to pay taxes, and there is truth to that, but it is so much broader than that. And the key is at the end: “which departed from the Lord our God.”

This is the compassion we have to have to push this out to our people and speak to it properly: reach in, touch their soul, make it alive. Babylon speaks plainly; why aren't we? We have to rise up and fight that.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 6 The 4 Horsemen

precepts.why:

In Bolivia, in the documentary Even the Rain, the people said we can't afford to buy a bottle of water, so they were collecting rain water that came from the heavens, and the government was taxing them, and it caused a whole damn revolution, rioting. We look at it during the time of the conquest and think it is nothing, but that is a trickle effect all the way up to today. Nothing has changed; it just got more and more clever.
